item.title: Advice on a cycle protocol
item.description: I did a cycle of 350 sustanon with 200 deca dropped the sustanon down to 150 and did water based winstrol 50 every other day. On week 10-16 (I ate clean as you possibly could for prior two years)Added clen for last 16 days dropped calories by 20% I got results that were absolutely amazing. Didn’t do it for a show but for a vacation. Best shape of my life. ( I’ve done crazy cycles when I was in my 20s and 30s 1600 -2000 mg a week) I had the want to make an omelette you gotta break some eggs minds

item.title: First cycle, wondering about adding winstrol to the middle of my cycle
item.description: Winstrol and clen turn magical if used properly But zero reason if over 15% bodyfat Get the diet dialed in. Get the body peaked out naturally then think about getting on gear. Do the bloodwork and the research before you get in the game. You don’t want to screw up your hormones It’s a lifestyle not gambling
